tier: Sandbox on a Mac Studio M5 Max

free_tier.stated: $5.00 of free credit, no card needed; a new personal account gets $5 once per person, and organization teams get no additional signup credit. At $1.10 an hour the grant is about 4.5 hours of sandbox time.
free_tier.notes: The credit is a one-time personal signup grant, not a recurring monthly allowance. It must cover the sandbox's reservation, which is its timeout at $1.10 an hour.

per_object_cap.stated: a sandbox file write or read may be up to 2 GiB; task artifacts at most 32 names of 100 MiB each, with 256 MiB per task and 512 MiB per team stored
per_object_cap.notes: 2 GiB is the per-file cap, not a sandbox disk quota; sandbox disk is not stated as a separate number.

retention.stated: A sandbox's files are wiped when it closes; task artifacts are kept 7 days after the task ends, recordings 7 days after the last picture or entry, ended task records 30 days, and snapshots expire after 30 days without a successful restore.
retention.notes: Days are the artifact and recording retention window. Sandbox home files do not survive closure; snapshots are the durable option.

egress.terms: unverified: the pricing page, the public API guide and the docs index name no egress price or traffic quota; the sandbox API allows outbound internet use through the Mac, and a locally listening TCP server can be reachable outside the sandbox, but no included transfer volume or per-GB rate is published

interface_detail: Every call is JSON under https://api.offstage.cloud/v1 with a Bearer sk_offstage_ team API key; a JavaScript SDK installs from a versioned tarball, and GitHub Actions jobs use runs-on: offstage-macos. GUI sandboxes add screenshots, clicks, typing and computer-use goals.
tooling: npm install https://api.offstage.cloud/sdk/offstage-cloud-0.3.4.tgz; the JS SDK exposes Sandbox and Task. REST clients can call /v1 directly with a team key. The user installs and runs the SDK or CLI against the hosted Mac fleet.
chaining: Hosted macOS sandboxes run Xcode builds, tests and computer-use agents and hand artifacts back over the API; a fleet slot is wiped between customers, so durable output must be downloaded or snapshotted.

limits.value: 120 requests a minute per team and 600 a minute per client address; sign-ups 5 an hour, sign-ins and verifications 20 a minute
at most 4 tasks or CI jobs claimed or running per team, with 16 more queued; no fixed team limit on open sandboxes
a sandbox lives 15 minutes by default, never more than 24 hours from creation, and closes after 10 idle minutes by default
a sandbox file write or read may be up to 2 GiB; 24 MiB of file writes held at once per team

limits_note: Creating work reserves its worst case, its timeoutMs at $1.10 an hour, until it ends; a 24-hour sandbox reserves $26.40, more than the $5 signup credit, so work must fit in remaining credit or be refused with 402.
binding_note: The 120-requests-a-minute team ceiling is the first hard count reached by an agent driving a sandbox with many small calls; the credit reservation is a payment gate rather than a quota, and the 4-task concurrency cap only binds for CI workloads.

identity_cost.detail: Signup takes {email, password, name?} with a password of at least 10 characters, and emails a verification link; until the owner opens it the team cannot create sandboxes, tasks or API keys. The console also offers GitHub and Google sign-in through Clerk. No card is needed for the $5 signup credit; a card is added only later to buy more credit.

reliability_note: Macs queue sandboxes when no slot is ready and a pending sandbox closes as no-capacity after 15 minutes; a GUI pause or busy slot can refuse work, and a Mac that stops answering closes the sandbox as box-lost and bills only to the Mac's last answer. Files and processes are wiped when a slot closes.
confidence_note: The rate, signup credit, limits, sign-up gate and retention windows are quoted from offstage.cloud's own pricing and docs pages and the api.offstage.cloud API guide read 2026-11-24. Egress terms are not published, so that field is unverified.
